t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each  pair will have one gnome that will lead you to a forest that has the better mushroom count.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will lead you to two different forests, each forest has it's own colored basket (yellow or red). The orange, green, blue and red gnomes will lead you to the non-windy forest whereas the brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes will lead you to the windy forest. Pay attention to which forest tends to give you the most mushrooms and which gnomes will lead you to that forest. I found that in my first two games that the forest that gave me the most mushrooms did not change and so I stuck with the same choices for those two. On the third game this seemed to have changed and I was unable to figure out the pattern until towards the end, I recommend trying to figure this out asap by changing your initial choices from part 1 and 2.In the fourth and final part of the game it was opposite of my first two and I quickly managed to figure this out. This allowed me to get the most points possible.
